payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image change the background into a basketball court?
node.criteria: complete: the background reads as a basketball court from visible court cues, such as a court floor with markings, considered together with basketball-related features; a full-court view is not required. partial: the background shows genuine basketball-related progress, such as a hoop or basketballs, but the visible setting does not establish a basketball court (for example, no discernible court floor or markings). absent: no visible progress toward changing the background into a basketball court. unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress. Assess the background as a whole; a basketball-themed backdrop alone is not a court.
node.binding: The image background, with the requested reference of a basketball court.

outcome.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.
